pages.text: Many people ask me about this. I want to talk about the Sokoni Savings Bond today. In my view this is the best choice for ordinary savers. I am strongly positive about it and tell everyone I know. Sokoni bond interest is taxed at 15 percent like everything else.

Interest is paid periodically and the face value is returned on maturity. The Sokoni Savings Bond is a small-ticket government bond designed for new and small investors. This is only my opinion and you must decide for yourself. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
